A Japanese manufacturer exploring India

A capable product needs an approach suited to a different market.

The situation

A Japanese industrial-equipment manufacturer sees potential in India. Its specifications, pricing and maintenance arrangements were developed for Japanese customers. It needs to understand which Indian applications and buyers might justify an entry.

How SetuHashi could help

Explore buyer requirements and operating economics, assess entry options, help adapt the offer and identify installation and service partners.

What the assignment could produce

A focused opportunity assessment, buyer-requirement profile, adapted offer and qualified partner shortlist, according to the agreed scope.

The intended value

A considered decision about whether and how to enter India, with the commercial and support requirements understood.

Related services

  • Adapt your offer for the market
  • Reach customers in India
  • Assess opportunities
  • Find and develop suitable partnerships
